description: List the brand's tool pages (forms at /tools/{slug} on the brand's domain that forward to the client's own backend, or capture leads with no backend at all). short {id,name,slug,isPublished,layout}; medium adds kind (proxy|none), endpointMethod, resultType, handoffMode, usageLimitPerDay, usageCount, apiKeyLast4, description, webUrl, timestamps; full = raw (still never includes apiKey — see module notes). limit (default 10, max 50) caps the returned rows; apiKey is write-only, never returned — see tool_get.

cursor.description: Reserved for forward-compatible pagination — the brand tools list has no pagination today.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: tool_list
